description: Updates an existing, non-canceled Stripe subscription by its ID, including supported item, billing, payment, tax, cancellation, and metadata settings.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for updating an existing Stripe subscription. Allows modification of items, billing, payment methods, and metadata.

automatic_tax.description: Stripe Tax settings for automatic tax calculation. `liability` may be required if `enabled` is true.

enabled.description: Determines whether Stripe automatically calculates taxes for this subscription. If true, `liability` may be required.
enabled.title: Enabled

liability.description: The account that's liable for tax. Required if `enabled` is `true` and the subscription is not a top-up.

connected_account.description: Stripe account ID liable for this subscription's taxes; required if `automatic_tax[enabled]` is true and subscription isn't a top-up.

liability.title: AutomaticTaxLiability

automatic_tax.title: AutomaticTax

cancel_at_period_end.title: Cancel At Period End

default_payment_method.description: ID of the default payment method; updates subscription's default payment source if provided.
default_payment_method.title: Default Payment Method

description.description: Arbitrary string for user display or internal tracking.

items.description: List of subscription item updates (max 20). Item `id` usually required for modification.
Defines the parameters for updating a specific item within a subscription.

billing_thresholds.description: Usage-based billing thresholds for this item; meeting a threshold generates an invoice for its usage.

billing_thresholds.title: BillingThresholds

discounts.description: List of discounts (by coupon, promotion code, or discount ID) to apply, replacing existing item discounts.

coupon.description: The ID of a coupon to apply. Mutually exclusive with `promotion_code` and `discount`.
coupon.title: Coupon

discount.description: The ID of an existing discount object to apply. This is less common than using `coupon` or `promotion_code`. Mutually exclusive with `coupon` and `promotion_code`.
discount.title: Discount

promotion_code.description: The ID of a promotion code to apply. Mutually exclusive with `coupon` and `discount`.
promotion_code.title: Promotion Code

discounts.title: Discounts

id.description: ID of the subscription item to update; required to modify. If omitted with `price`, new item behavior varies; explicit creation often preferred.
id.title: Id

quantity.description: Quantity of this item; affects metered billing amount or sets units for licensed billing.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs for custom information (max 50 keys: 40 chars; values: 500 chars). Replaces existing; empty dict removes all.

subscription_id.title: Subscription Id
